name: zombie-cafe
description: A 2D fan recreation of the classic Zombie Cafe management game, wrapped for iOS via Capacitor.

scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/assets && cp index.html www/ && cp manifest.webmanifest www/ && cp sw.js www/ && cp -R css www/ && cp -R js www/ && cp -R icons www/ && cp -R assets/art www/assets/ 2>/dev/null || true
